svg.title: The law of cosines: u minus v
svg.desc: Vectors u and v start at the origin O. u points horizontally right and has length a. v points up and right and has length b. Their angle is gamma. The third side, from the tip of v to the tip of u, is u minus v and has length c.

g.text: For ‖x+y‖, use u = x and v = −y: the angle changes.
